summary: Reinvented chess! A puzzle & strategy board game with a mighty dragon & more.
description: Welcome to Chessarama, a collection of puzzle and strategy games that reinvents the classic board game of chess! If you love a good puzzle or a deep strategy challenge, you'll find a whole universe to explore. Chessarama offers a modern way to play games inspired by chess, without needing to be a grandmaster. Explore our unique strategy games: 🐲 Dragon Slayer This is a deadly strategy puzzle. You must guide your pawn to defeat a mighty dragon. But it will not be that easy! The dragon attacks the board every time the pawn moves and every undefended piece will die. 🌸 Lady Ronin In this unique puzzle, chess meets Sokoban! You play as a Ronin (a chess queen) in a tactical board game challenge. Your strategy must be perfect: you need to eliminate the other pieces to get close to the Shogun and capture it. ⚽ Soccer Chess In this unique strategy game, you will play a soccer match using chess pieces. Your strategy will need to be a few moves ahead if you want to break through the adversary's defenses to score a goal. Game Features: ✔️ Explore a huge collection of chess-inspired strategy games ✔️ Master 100+ levels in our puzzle campaigns ✔️ Collect 24 rare and exclusive Chess Figures ✔️ Compete on the leaderboards in daily and weekly challenges ✔️ Learn chess strategy and tactics in a fun new way ✔️ Includes Classic Chess, the ultimate board game! Whether you're a fan of board games, looking for a new puzzle to solve, or a lover of deep strategy games, Chessarama has a challenge for you. Download now and start your journey into a new world of chess! ===Information=== Official Discord: https://discord.gg/ysYuUhcx7k Player Support: help.chessarama@minimolgames.com
